purpose: 15-utterance Hinglish/code-mixed test set (council Day-1 gate). Run each through the pipeline — ideally once clean, once with mandi ambience layered — and check the expected entity survived in the transcript.
usage: Say each aloud in the app, or synthesize via /api/tts and feed the WAV to /api/stt. Verify expected_keywords appear in transcript (allowing Devanagari OR romanized forms).
